read.text:
How to read this (second version, after M57)

The city screen and the advisor page now follow the game's own panels: dark translucent boxes, gold headings, the domestic advisor's table of cities. Click the sectors and tabs.

Each good has a category (what it is) and a sector (basic resources, essential needs, artisanal, industrial, luxury). Which good sits in which sector is my proposal, to confirm.

Cloth, cheese and wheat seed are not goods yet: they show the artisanal sector and seed stocks as recipes (IN.F1) and seeds (TR.F3) would add them.

Food is counted as nutrition met: protein (fish, dairy, meat) counts most; preserved foods keep longest (D27).

Every quantity is made up. The Civilopedia, plot help and contract boards still have the first version's look.
